Mission Local reported that MEDA was under contract to buy the four-story building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of the BART station, and planned to rehabilitate it into 62 permanent affordable homes. The units would include two single-room occupancy units, 54 studios and six one-bedroom units. The project depended on city approval of a loan through the Small Sites Program; MEDA said it hoped to close by September 2024. The ground-floor businesses were expected to remain, with accessibility upgrades planned.
